$description: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule id is implemented with the same id in schema/semantic_validate.py; verify_all.py checks the two lists are identical.

rules.rule: shell.site-header is the first node and shell.site-footer the last node of every page.
At most one HERO-category node per page.
exceptions: Template contact-split is hero-less by design: conversion.demo-request-split opens the page (templates.json heroless=true).

rules.rule: The HERO node is the first non-shell node.
exceptions: app-detail: navigation.breadcrumb-bar precedes hero.app-header; help-docs: navigation.docs-sidebar precedes the opener (templates.json heroAfter).

rules.rule: Sections with constraints.homeRouteOnly (hero.product-window) only appear on route '/'.
constraints.onePerPage / maxPerPage from each section contract.
The same (section, variant) never appears twice in a row unless the template node is repeatable.
Two adjacent non-shell nodes should not share a category.
exceptions: CONTENT runs are normal inside long-form bodies (app overview chapters, story chapters/prose/statements).
FEATURES runs are normal on this site (home, app-partners, expert-partners place 2-4 capability sections in a row, separated by hairlines).
PRICING: comparison-header -> comparison-group and repeated groups.
LISTING: directory-header -> directory-category and repeated categories.
CONTENT: repeated article chapters; app-meta-sidebar -> article-chapter.
SOCIAL_PROOF pairs measured on real pages: scale-stats -> customer-stories (home), logo-wall -> customer-stories (customers).

rules.rule: Sections with constraints.mustPrecedeFooter (conversion.final-cta, conversion.avatar-wall-cta, navigation.partner-cross-links) sit directly before the footer.
features.developer-platform directly follows features.context-horizon (they form one dark curtain stack).
testimonial.quote variant scroll-curtain directly follows features.developer-platform or features.context-horizon (it slides under the dark stack).
pricing.comparison-group requires pricing.comparison-header before it; listing.directory-category requires listing.directory-header before it; repeated groups/categories/chapters are contiguous.
Long-form body blocks (content.prose-split, content.lit-statement, content.scroll-scene, features.launch-showcase) need a content.chapter-header somewhere before them.
Sections with retrievalEligible=false (overlays) are never page nodes; templates list them under runtimeOverlays.
At most 5 nodes per page use continuous motion (badge-comet, auto-cycle-tabs, marquee-loop, ambient-streaks, decorative-loop). The measured home page uses 5.
